description: This is a shell script used for managing firmware downloads and updates for network devices. It handles retrieving configuration from XCONF servers, supports multiple connection methods (direct, Codebig), manages reboot procedures, delays, and retries, and incorporates state management and device-specific logic. The script orchestrates firmware upgrade checks, download initiation, and recovery from failure states, with detailed logging and environment management.

methods.name: getCurrentFw
methods.description: Retrieves the current firmware version from the /version.txt file.

methods.name: getRequestType
methods.description: Determines the request type based on the server hostname.

methods.name: checkFirmwareUpgCriteria
methods.description: Checks if the current firmware version matches the requested firmware for upgrade eligibility.

methods.name: IsCodebigBlocked
methods.description: Checks if Codebig is currently blocked due to previous failures.

methods.name: get_Codebigconfig
methods.description: Retrieves and applies Codebig configuration settings.

methods.name: do_Codebig_signing
methods.description: Performs signing of requests for Codebig communication.

methods.name: useDirectRequest
methods.description: Initiates a firmware download request over a direct connection.

methods.name: useCodebigRequest
methods.description: Initiates a firmware download request over Codebig.

methods.name: checkFirmwareUpgCriteria_temp
methods.description: Temporary function to check firmware upgrade criteria based on temporary response data.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpgDetail
methods.description: Main function to contact XCONF server, retrieve firmware details and initiate download.

methods.name: fetchFirmwareDetail
methods.description: Fetches firmware download details from the last saved response.

methods.name: calcRandTime
methods.description: Calculates a random time within specified windows for firmware checks or reboots to avoid congestion.
